opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together interdisciplinary groups to analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: £500 per year for 10 years (first five years' funding of £3,500 claimable in year 1, additional £3,500 in year 6)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners and university academics; awarded to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, supporting long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning, funding research on education methods within ecology.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; awarded to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, allowing an ecologist to be immersed in another professional world for up to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES membership required; funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: Maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses; maximum of £500 for in-person events

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher; work or study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within ecology remit.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs.
